WASHINGTON — The U.S. Department of the Treasury is offering $90 billion of Treasury securities to refund approximately $70 billion of privately-held Treasury notes and bonds maturing on November 15, 2026.
This issuance will raise new cash from private investors of approximately $20 billion.
A 3-year note in the amount of $40 billion, maturing November 15, 2029;
The 3-year note will be auctioned at 1:00 p.m. ET on Monday, October 26, 2026.
A 10-year note in the amount of $30 billion, maturing November 15, 2036;
The 10-year note will be auctioned at 1:00 p.m. ET on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
A 30-year bond in the amount of $20 billion, maturing November 15, 2056.
The 30-year bond will be auctioned at 1:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, October 29, 2026.
